note: Evidence abridged by the author from the critic's full report; verdicts and preference verbatim.
reads_as_reason: Stacked rounded blocks with a boxy head, very wide shoulders, straight tube limbs and a slab backpack; the candidate also removes most of the dark joint recesses, so it reads as white blocks, not a shell over a dark structure.

G1.evidence: Squared-off head with a horizontal slit visor reads as goggles/helmet toy; huge shoulder boxes; A-pose; tub-shaped pelvis (P3 0.422, P2a 0.1324).

G2.evidence: Chest, waist, pelvis are three blocks with a ledge at the pelvis tub; knee is a hairline seam, not a recess; joints are thin lines (P8a 0.9626, P8b 0.9242, S4b 0.6186).

G3.evidence: Palette correct, but the dark share is too small: the black waist band of the brief is missing and the joint recesses are hairlines.

G4.evidence: Head, shoulders and pelvis squarish with tight radii; forearms and thighs softer tubes; sharp backpack; dark gaps inconsistent (hairline arm bands, closed knee, chunky black hands and feet).

G6.evidence: Shoulders and arms far wider than the references; legs straight columns; references have a narrow waist, tapered limbs and a capsule head. IoU 0.5266 / 0.5578.

pairwise.evidence: Same massing; the baseline's full-face visor, thick waist, elbow and knee bands and Optimus-like black waist band get closer to white shells over a dark under-structure. The candidate's goggle slit and hairline joints make the legs look like stacked pipe and the head more toy-like, despite its higher numeric pass fraction (0.684 vs 0.632).

top_changes.change: Restore deliberate dark recesses: deepen and widen the waist, knee and elbow gaps; bring back the black waist band.
Cut the shoulder width and bring the arms down; replace the goggle slit with a full-face visor on a softer, rounder head with a longer neck.
Taper thigh and shank; shorten the foot.

notes: Preference rests mainly on the two-tone (visor and joint-band treatment); lineup crops the arms.
